column1: # Differences that are by design or already tracked by an issue.
# Tab-separated Python regexes, searched (empty matches anything): class,
# shape (the group title after the class), case, "request-id nginx-status",
# values as "nginx -> ruxen"; then why. A matching difference is listed as
# expected, not as new. Drop a tracking rule when its issue is fixed.

column6: #582: ruxen sends `Connection: close` upstream when it won't keep the connection (nginx 1.30 sends none), by design
nginx's range filter turns the 200 into a 416 after the header filters ran: `add_header … always` headers come twice; ruxen sends them once
nginx's range filter turns the 200 into a 416 after the header filters ran: the 200's `add_header`/`expires` headers stay on the 416; ruxen's 416 has only the `always` ones
#748: ruxen drops a #fragment nginx keeps in $request_uri and the proxied request line
#781: an absolute-form HTTP/1.1 request without Host is served
#784: ruxen refuses HTTP/0.9 with a 400 at once; nginx answers with the body alone, by design
